output.one_liner: Adobe Commerce is a cloud-based e-commerce platform enabling merchants to build and manage multichannel commerce experiences, available as SaaS, self-hosted on-premises, and open-source.

auth.notes: OAuth 1.0a (not 2.0) for third-party integrations; Bearer tokens (IMS Access Token) for Cloud/SaaS; login credentials for admin/customer UI

evidence.snippet: Adobe Commerce REST APIs support multiple authentication methods, including:
OAuth authentication with Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source is based on OAuth 1.0a
Both of these authentication methods require every request to be signed with an IMS Access Token.

access.notes: Magento Open Source (free, open-source self-hostable) enables free credential generation via Admin integration creation. Adobe Commerce Cloud/SaaS pricing model and free trial/sandbox availability not specified.

evidence.snippet: Adobe Commerce on Cloud, Adobe Commerce on-premises, and Magento Open Source all use the same REST API
Create a new integration on Admin. To create an integration, click System Extensions Integration Add New Integration

evidence.snippet: Support for GraphQL, REST (Representational State Transfer) and SOAP (Simple Object Access Protocol).
Adobe Commerce provides a wide range of REST API endpoints that allow you to perform actions
Webhooks enable developers to configure synchronous logic to execute calls to external systems

buildability.rationale: REST/GraphQL/SOAP APIs and webhooks fully documented; Magento Open Source provides free self-serve development environment using identical core APIs as commercial Adobe Commerce.

The Commerce Web APIs allow you to integrate third-party software and build headless applications
